review.alt: Side profile of a young woman with no visible makeup and her hair in a loose bun, sitting by a bright window and looking straight ahead at a smartphone propped on a shelf at her eye height, with her chin level and a neutral expression.

Illustrated close-up of a green eye with a thin black winged liner flicking up toward the tail of a softly lifted brow, with upper lashes fanned upward and outward; beside it on a light marble surface lie a black eyeliner pencil, a brown brow pencil with a spoolie end, and a separate spoolie brush.

imageFailures.error: Image 1 failed validation: Image failed editorial review: ["Brief asked for three pairs of eyes (upturned, level, downturned) in a soft editorial illustration; the image instead shows three near-identical full-face, photorealistic portraits of a woman, not an illustration focused on eyes.","The canthal tilt differences are barely perceptible or absent: all three faces have essentially the same neutral-to-slightly-different eye angle, so the image fails to illustrate positive, neutral and negative tilt categories at a glance.","The three panels appear to be the same face with minimal variation, which could mislead readers into thinking subtle or no differences define the categories; no clear upturned vs. downturned contrast is visible.","Composition (full faces, hair, neck, shoulders) distracts from the eye shape focus and does not match the 'pairs of eyes side by side' brief."]
